top_signals.title: Legal sector warns against tax ‘raid’ proposal on client account interest ahead of Budget
top_signals.summary: London’s legal sector has sounded the alarm over government plans to cut interest on law firms’ client accounts to fund the justice department, warning it could drive some law firms out of business. The Ministry of Justice’s consultation on a proposal to introduce an Interest on Lawyers’ Client Accounts Scheme (ICLA) closed in March after [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Investors who have shunned diversification face maybe the best buying opportunity for bonds in decades
top_signals.summary: No diversification needed: The 10-year total return stocks minus bonds is near the highest in history.
